label: Rental move-out
description: Condition check of a unit when a tenant leaves.
hint: This is a rental move-out inspection. Areas are rooms of a home. Items are fixtures, surfaces and appliances.
examples: kitchen outlet next to sink has no gfci
water stain on bathroom ceiling about 30 cm wide
hairline crack on living room north wall, roughly 16 inches

label: Warehouse safety walk-through
description: Hazards and defects across a storage or logistics site.
hint: This is a warehouse safety walk-through. Areas are zones of an industrial site. Items are equipment, racking, doors, floors and safety gear.
examples: loading dock door seal torn along the bottom edge
storage rack upright bent about 6 inches near aisle 3
extension cord running across the office walkway

label: Construction punch list
description: Open items before a build is handed over.
hint: This is a construction punch list. Areas are parts of a building under construction. Items are finishes, fittings and installations that are incomplete or defective.
examples: stairwell handrail loose at the second floor landing
unit 101 bathroom tile grout missing, about 2 ft along the tub
roof drain blocked with debris, standing water

label: Restaurant health check
hint: This is a restaurant health check. Areas are parts of a food service site. Items are equipment, surfaces, food storage and hygiene stations.
examples: walk-in cooler door gasket torn, door does not seal
kitchen hand sink has no soap
dry storage boxes stored directly on the floor

label: Custom
description: Any other site visit. You name it, areas come from your notes.
hint: This is a site visit. Areas are the places on the site that the note mentions.
examples: server room door does not latch
parking lot light pole 4 is out
water pooling by the north entrance, about 1 m wide
